summary: Specific performance of sale agreement dated 24.05.1981; parties dispute Rs.2,000/- advance payment; three-month period for registration subject to government restrictions lifted; plaintiff's readiness to perform contested; defendants' sale to third parties after purported forfeiture; Trial Court decree for specific performance upheld by High Court; appeal dismissed; possession never transferred to plaintiffs.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; Trial Court decree for specific performance upheld.
